Package loveletter.viewmodel

Class LoginViewModel

java.lang.Object
loveletter.viewmodel.LoginViewModel
public class LoginViewModel extends Object
Coordinates nickname registration with the server.

Public methods must be called on the JavaFX application thread. Network operations run on a background thread.
